name: Fire Elemental
primary:
A fire elemental appears in front of you and follows you for 60 s. At most 2 elementals serve you at once: a third one replaces the oldest. It attacks monsters nearby and whoever fights you, and never harms you or your allies.
Flies next to you and shoots homing fireballs every 1.3 s from up to 13 blocks:
• Damage 2.5 ❤ fire
• Heat 60: sets targets on fire
Immune to fire.
self_description: The elemental appears right next to you.
